metadata.description: Collection of Agent Skills for Notifly.

plugins.name: notifly-integration
plugins.description: Integrates Notifly SDK into iOS/Android/Flutter/React Native projects. Use when the user asks to install/setup/integrate Notifly, or when the user types "notifly-integration".

plugins.name: migrate-from-braze
plugins.description: Migrates Braze SDK integrations to Notifly across iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native, Expo, and Web. Use when the user asks to migrate, replace, coexist, or churn Braze in favor of Notifly.

plugins.name: migrate-from-onesignal
plugins.description: Migrates OneSignal SDK integrations to Notifly across iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native, Expo, and Web. Use when the user asks to migrate, replace, coexist, or churn OneSignal in favor of Notifly.
